title: Krishna Lifts Govardhan Hill
on_screen_title: The Boy Who Lifted a Mountain
style: Soft 3D animated film look, warm golden light, rich saturated colours, cinematic depth of field, vertical 9:16 composition, no text
character: Krishna: 7-year-old boy, deep blue skin, big kind eyes, gentle smile, black curly hair, gold crown with one peacock feather, yellow silk dhoti, gold armlets, bamboo flute tucked in waist sash

scenes.narration: What happens when a seven-year-old boy challenges the king of the gods?
scenes.image_prompt: Krishna standing on a green hilltop at sunrise, looking up confidently at a vast stormy sky where a giant shadowy figure on a white elephant looms in the clouds

scenes.narration: Every year, the people of Vrindavan offered a grand feast to Indra, the lord of rain.
scenes.image_prompt: Village of Vrindavan, villagers in colourful clothes carrying baskets of sweets, fruits and pots of milk toward a decorated altar, cows and marigold garlands everywhere

scenes.narration: But little Krishna said, 'Govardhan Hill feeds our cows and shelters our forests. Let us honour the hill instead.'
scenes.image_prompt: Krishna smiling and pointing toward a lush green mountain, talking to his father Nanda and the village elders who listen with surprise

scenes.narration: Indra watched from the heavens, and his pride burned like lightning.
scenes.image_prompt: Indra, king of gods, golden armour and crown, sitting on the white elephant Airavata above dark clouds, face angry, lightning crackling in his hand

scenes.narration: He sent a terrible storm. Rain lashed the village, rivers overflowed, and the frightened people ran to Krishna.
scenes.image_prompt: Violent rainstorm over Vrindavan at night, flooding river, villagers and calves running through the rain toward young Krishna who stands calm and glowing

scenes.narration: Krishna walked to Govardhan, and with just one little finger, he lifted the whole mountain like an umbrella.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-angle epic shot: Krishna lifting the entire Govardhan mountain on the little finger of his left hand, smiling, rain pouring around, divine golden glow beneath the mountain

scenes.narration: For seven days and nights, every family and every cow stayed safe beneath it.
scenes.image_prompt: Under the lifted mountain: warm lamp-lit shelter, families, children and cows huddled together happily, Krishna holding the mountain above them, rain curtain outside

scenes.narration: At last, Indra understood. He bowed before Krishna, and the storm melted into sunshine.
scenes.image_prompt: Indra kneeling and bowing with folded hands before smiling Krishna, clouds parting, golden sunbeams and a rainbow over the mountain

scenes.narration: Pride always falls. But whoever trusts Krishna is never left alone in the storm.
scenes.image_prompt: Krishna sitting on a rock playing his flute at golden sunset, cows grazing around him, Govardhan Hill peaceful behind, peacocks, soft glowing light

youtube.description:
When Indra, king of the gods, sent a terrible storm on Vrindavan, little Krishna lifted Govardhan Hill on one finger to protect everyone. A Krishna story in 60 seconds.
